defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It computes shortest-path distances between terminals and then treats those distances as a terminal MST, which can count shared relay edges multiple times and is not equivalent to a minimum Steiner tree.
Its shortest-path routine restricts traversal to the supplied terminal-node set, so it excludes non-critical relay hubs and cannot discover cheaper Steiner connections.
It uses an all-pairs shortest-path metric followed by a terminal MST-style computation, again losing the savings from sharing intermediate relay edges.
